label: phase0-layout-lint
note: Snapshot read after a rendered frame via window.__ui.lint(). Text nodes report w/h 0 because only Layer.layout() sizes them and the frame loop never calls it; those land in the zero-or-negative-size rule under bucket unmeasured-text. Rules text-overflow, unreachable-interactive and target-size are dormant in phase 0 for want of text.measured, focusable and pointerEvents.
